justification: Provides a clean mechanistic (Poisson-process) explanation for the empirically observed Gamma statistics of Collatz upward phases with extensive large-scale numerical validation, though it remains an approximation rather than a proof and addresses a niche problem.

Introduces a well-defined tiled Newton-Schulz formulation for Muon with thorough theoretical, diagnostic, and end-to-end GPU evaluation, though end-to-end wall-clock gains are modest (3-8%) and the training runs are single-seed.

Proposes a simple cross-class redundancy-pruning heuristic for WSI indexing that yields modest, variable storage savings but degrades minority-class F1, with abstract claims overstating robustness relative to the reported imbalanced-dataset degradation.

Presents a novel weight-level injection paradigm (GaRA) for graph-LLM adaptation with solid theory, a norm-amplification analysis, and consistent zero-shot gains, though it remains dependent on input-level prompting and is evaluated only on standard benchmarks.

Introduces a novel Analog Interaction System framework with principled expressivity-enhancing mechanisms and compelling energy estimates, though generative fidelity is moderate and the hardware efficiency claims rest on extrapolated power models rather than fabricated silicon.
